messages.subject: Regarding variable creation and selection
parts: I am a Masters student working on Maxent modeling for habitat correlates of a titi monkey species from Peru. The distribution area is greater than 10 sq.km but confined to Northern Peru. I want to use the current climatic variables from Worldclim and other ecological and anthropogenic variables like NDVI, Land cover, Human population intensity, Intensity of anthropogenic disturbance, distance to road, etc., Where can I download these variables other than Worldclim? or How can I create them for this species? Do we need to process them or can upload directly on User-specified variables in Wallace? I have basic knowledge of Maxent modeling. But I would like to learn. Kindly clarify.

messages.author: fe049c2835236bb1
messages.subject: Regarding variable creation and selection
parts:
Regarding the acquisition of predictor variables, I cannot recommend particular ones because they are all different--that's really up to you to find data sources (via Google Scholar, etc.), explore the characteristics of each one, then decide which are most appropriate for your data. If your analysis is country-specific, my first stop would be that country's GIS layers, if available from the Dept. of Environment, etc.

As for processing rasters, you will need to make sure they have the same resolution and extent before they go into Wallace. You can do this using ArcGIS (if you have access) or QGIS (free), among others.
